t-phone.text: Camera list on a phone: each camera on the Camera recording page becomes one folding row with a separate pause button, under one search field with the pattern workbench, and an open row holds every setting the camera has today.

n-main.text: Shows the Camera recording page on a phone with three cameras in one place. Each camera is now one folding row: a disclosure button with a camera icon, the name, state pill and a short summary line, and a separate 48 px Pause or Resume button beside it. Opening a row shows newest, waiting and oldest, How much to keep, and every setting the camera has today, in today's order. A Search cameras field with the pattern workbench sits under the intro, with a camera count and Expand all. Before: every camera is a table row with all of its settings spread out underneath, and there is no search. Try: open Front Door DOORBELL and record a test clip; open Garage, then What counts as seen, and untick Automatic; type "drive" or "paused" in the search, or use ^(front|garage) in the workbench. Unbuilt: all of it, including remembering which rows are open after a refresh or reload. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

n-openphone.text: Shows the Camera recording page on a phone with one camera open inside the /config/recordings card, under its four stat tiles and the keep slider. Each camera is a folding row: a disclosure button with the name, state pill and one summary line, and a separate 48 px Pause or Resume button beside it. The open row gets a tonal surface and holds everything the camera has today, in today's order: newest, waiting and oldest; How much to keep; live video around events; the recording check; the before and after sliders; what counts as seen; and Keep what is watched. Rows fold and open with a short transition. Try: fold and open rows or use Collapse all; in the light stage untick Automatic and choose event sources; record a test clip on Front Door DOORBELL. Unbuilt: all of it, including remembering open rows across a refresh and a reload. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

t-wide.text: Camera list on a wide window: the folding rows carry columns for how much to keep, newest recording, waiting to copy and oldest kept, and an open row lays its settings out in two columns.

n-listwide.text: Shows the Camera recording page on a wide window. Each camera is one folding row whose disclosure button carries columns: name and state pill, How much to keep, Newest recording, Waiting to copy and Oldest kept, with a separate Pause or Resume button at the end. One Search cameras field with the pattern workbench sits above, with a camera count and Expand all. Open, the settings sit in two columns: keep and live video on the left, the recording check and watched settings on the right. Before: a table row per camera with every setting spread out underneath and no search. Try: open Front Door DOORBELL and record a test clip; type "drive", build the pattern ^(front|garage), or type the broken pattern /(front/ to see its error while every camera stays listed; narrow the window below 860 px for stacked rows. Unbuilt: all of it, including remembering which rows are open across the 10 second refresh and a reload. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.

t-edge.text: Many cameras and edge cases: twelve cameras in two places with one search across both, long names at large text, the first load, the set-up card and the copy error.

n-edgephone.text: Shows the Camera recording page with twelve cameras in two places, "/config/recordings" and "NAS recordings", on a phone. Each place is a card with its stat tiles, space meter and keep slider, then one folding row per camera with a state pill, a one-line summary and a separate pause button; opening a row shows every setting the page has today. One search field with the pattern workbench filters both places by name, entity id, state, amount and place, and a place with no match says "No cameras here match." Other stages show text at 200% (bar and button labels at 150%) with the same camera names wrapping, the first-load skeleton, the set-up card and the copy error alert. Try: type "gar" in the search, open Garage and then "What counts as seen", press Expand all, then Pause all on the NAS card. Unbuilt: all of it; this is a new design. Tweaks: accent, motion, theme (dark or light), stage.
